_deal: The board's test node, until he plays it.
author: jessica
source: his 2026-11-02 10:36, after proving out the Ashta defense (MB98a) and reading the fauna list: "let's start with these on there planets: A Mossgnath thats trampling crops, put it down. Red Mile Mauler pack. Siren pack. Kreet Stalker defense"
_note: THE KREET STALKERS: MB98a's shape on Kreet (sound the alarm, hold three waves), his 'Kreet Stalker defense'. NARROW, as MB98a: pinned to the creature's own planet, so the words name the creature and the planet aloud (his exemption, 2026-10-26).

Creatures: PCM_Narion_Kreet_StalkerPredatorA (Starfield.esm), found 11-02 by gen_inspect. Lore (fandom): crab-like, wait for prey, burrow; tested by the UC Xenowarfare Division in 2306. Kept out of the words: the burrowing is the useful fact.
STAND-IN: place.planet 'Kreet' is not in the closed planet table yet, and Kreet has few sites; the pool is the first question.
A DRAFT ID: MB ids stop at two digits (MB99a was the last free one, 11-02), so this waits for gen_delve name, as missionboard33a became MB98a. The numbering cap is Eliza's to raise.

place._planet: STAND-IN: not in the closed planet table (only Akila). Eliza's to add.

prose.name: Defense: Kreet Stalkers at the <Place> on <Planet>
prose.briefing: Kreet stalkers have started coming up out of the ground around the <Place>. They wait, and then they don't. The crew want someone on the alarm and someone who can shoot.
prose.card: Settlement Contract. Help the <Place> on <Planet> hold against Kreet stalkers. Payment on contract completion.

broadcast: Get the alarm on so the crew gets inside. Stalkers come up out of the ground, so watch your feet as much as the horizon.

beats.name: Site Alarm
beats.journal: Kreet stalkers have been coming up around the <Place>. I sounded the alarm and the crew got inside, and now I need to hold the site.
say: Alarm's on and everyone's in. Now watch the ground.

beats.objective: Hold the <Place> against the Kreet stalkers
beats.journal: I held the <Place> against three waves of Kreet stalkers.
say: That's them gone back under. We'll leave the alarm where it is.
